name: check_room
description: Check whether one room is available for a requested interval within a single day. All times are whole minutes since midnight in the inclusive range 0–1440. Supply the current time, blocked status, and existing bookings explicitly; do not guess missing information. The tool only checks availability and does not save, create, or change a booking. The function evaluates ordering, future start, the 120-minute duration limit, blocked status, and overlaps; intervals touching at endpoints are allowed. Return Available or Unavailable. This interface has no date or room selector.

start.description: Requested start time. Whole minutes since midnight, inclusive range 0–1440; 10:00 = 600 and 24:00 = 1440.

end.description: Requested end time. Whole minutes since midnight, inclusive range 0–1440; 10:00 = 600 and 24:00 = 1440.

now.description: Current time explicitly supplied for the same day context. Whole minutes since midnight, inclusive range 0–1440; 10:00 = 600 and 24:00 = 1440.

blocked.description: Whether the room is blocked. Both true and false are valid inputs; the function decides availability.

bookings.description: All known existing bookings for the room in the same day context. An empty list is valid only when no bookings are present.

start.description: Existing booking start. Whole minutes since midnight, inclusive range 0–1440; 10:00 = 600 and 24:00 = 1440.

end.description: Existing booking end. Whole minutes since midnight, inclusive range 0–1440; 10:00 = 600 and 24:00 = 1440.
